question: How many people do not have access to the internet? (completely offline)
answer_explanation: The Offline Population: Conversely, about 2.17 billion people remain completely offline or unconnected. So 260 people in our Planet1000 have no access to the internet.

relationship_fact.text: India crossed 800 million internet users in 2023 — a single country now has more people online than the entire world did in 2005, reflecting how fast connectivity has spread

temporal_fact.text: By 2023, India had more internet users than the number of internet users in the entire world back in 2005. In other words, internet penetration has been dramatic in the last 2 decades.

anchor_fact.text: Sub-Saharan Africa has the lowest internet penetration of any world region — around 40% of people were online in 2023, compared to over 90% in Europe and North America
